title: Libra × Taurus: two Venus signs, one dessert.
old_caption: Agreeing on most things still leaves room for small standoffs. Make the little decision, share the last bite, and when in doubt, order two desserts.

title: Virgo × Leo: the helper and the headliner.
old_caption: Quiet care deserves to be noticed out loud. Take the thank-you when it comes, notice the small things your person does, and give the helper a moment in the light.

title: Pisces × Sagittarius: the dream and the dare.
old_caption: Big dreams feel safer when you're not rushing them. Slow the dare to someday, say what you need tonight, and plan one dream a year together. Save this for your planning night.

title: Taurus × Pisces: the blanket and the waterworks.
old_caption: Some people cry at the sad part. Some cry at the opening titles. Let the steady one hold you, and let them say the soft thing out loud. Tag your movie-night person.

title: Cancer × Scorpio: the shell and the vault.
old_caption: Two people saying "fine" can drift a long way apart. Say the real thing, go first sometimes, and agree that "fine?" means "tell me more."

title: Gemini × Libra: the invites and the yes-es.
old_caption: Saying yes to every invite can leave no time for each other. Check in, decline kindly, and remember the walk home counts too. Save this for party season.

title: Sagittarius × Capricorn: the season handover.
old_caption: Adventure and planning make a good team when both get a turn. Finish one thing, keep one wild day, and plan the next trip together.

title: Cancer × Leo: the photo and the family.
old_caption: Holiday photos get serious fast. Leave room for everyone, ask for the photo you want, and keep the blurry one where everyone is laughing.

title: Libra × Pisces: the hike neither of them wanted.
old_caption: Pretending to love a date to keep the peace still costs you something. Gentle honesty is how you find the plan you both enjoy.

title: Scorpio × Capricorn: who says it first.
old_caption: Waiting for them to say it first can turn into waiting forever. Feelings don't need a deadline, just a little courage. Who said it first in your story?
